set.body: Add DesignExportError and Either-returning variants for designTable, designMap, correlationMap, eventPlotData, baselinePlotData, and contrastPlotData. Keep current throwing helpers as compatibility wrappers. Acceptance: normal user mistakes such as missing term names, empty contrasts, and sampling/design row mismatch are represented as structured errors and covered on JVM/JS.
set.title: Design: total DesignExports APIs
